anomalies.title: Deload 3 uses a literal 76 percent middle set
BBB Challenge retains intermediate deload-like weeks when deload is off
anomalies.sourceBehavior: Some intermediate deloads become High Intensity work.
anomalies.targetBehavior: No deload week or deload exercise is emitted when Deload is disabled.

anomalies.title: Unit switch does not convert entered values
anomalies.sourceBehavior: The source changes the unit label without converting numeric values.
anomalies.targetBehavior: HybridTraining converts or explicitly asks before changing units.

anomalies.title: Source overflows horizontally at 320 pixels
anomalies.sourceBehavior: The observed page exceeds the viewport by approximately five pixels.
anomalies.targetBehavior: No horizontal page overflow at 320 pixels.

anomalies.title: Invalid program URL can leave an empty page
anomalies.sourceBehavior: An invalid ?program= payload is not always recovered.
anomalies.targetBehavior: Show a recoverable structured error and a usable default form.

anomalies.title: Negative or empty plate inventory can crash plating
anomalies.sourceBehavior: Invalid inventory is not safely rejected in every path.
anomalies.targetBehavior: Reject negative inventory and handle an empty inventory without crashing.

anomalies.title: Empty or zero ratio silently falls back to 90 percent
anomalies.sourceBehavior: Invalid ratio input is silently normalized to the default.

anomalies.title: Full Body Updated first Deadlift profile is 3/3/3
anomalies.sourceBehavior: The first Deadlift profile differs from the visible 5/5/5 family.

anomalies.title: Bodyweight distributes rounding remainder at an edge
anomalies.sourceBehavior: Rounded early sets receive the remainder at the beginning or end.

anomalies.title: Plating prefers the higher load on an equal-distance tie
anomalies.sourceBehavior: The closest-load search breaks ties upward and caps at inventory maximum.

anomalies.title: Several source controls are not fully accessible
anomalies.sourceBehavior: Drag/drop, plate controls and some fields lack robust keyboard or touch semantics.
anomalies.targetBehavior: Keyboard, pointer and touch alternatives with accessible names and focus.

anomalies.title: Program units are mutable global generator state
anomalies.sourceBehavior: Generation depends on a mutable global programUnits value.
anomalies.targetBehavior: The Dart core stays pure and receives units in every request.

anomalies.title: Rotating schedules can mix movement wave positions
anomalies.sourceBehavior: A displayed week may contain movements belonging to different wave positions.
